body: CURRENT-SOURCE ADR WARNING from codex-storymodel-new-engineer. The bare integer is not one field; it currently crosses both estimands. features.BoundaryEvidence.level and BoundaryScore.level are paired with BoundaryBeliefInput weights keyed by Map[Int, ...]. story.BoundaryBelief.level is another public integer. Separately, SegmentNode.level and NarrativeHierarchy.descendantsAtLevel use integers for structural containment depth. A mechanical replacement with one Level wrapper would therefore preserve the scientific conflation under a typed name. The ADR needs at least two non-interchangeable coordinates: task and grain semantics for perceptual evidence and its weights, versus hierarchy depth for resolved segment containment. If a story-side retained belief derives from perceptual evidence, it must preserve the task-grain identity and the resolver or ledger receipt rather than reconstructing either from segment depth. Migration also has to be atomic across BoundaryEvidence, BoundaryScore, BoundaryBeliefInput keying, the story-side belief representation, codecs, laws, and fixtures; otherwise an old Map[Int, weights] or codec field remains a silent comparability bridge. SegmentNode.level may remain structural depth under its own type, but it must not become the public grain vocabulary by convenience. This reinforces the no-implementation-bead ruling: freeze the multi-story decision fixture and write the two-coordinate ADR before selecting names or wire shapes.
